name: Account Access Errors
description: Customers cannot access their accounts and may see an unclear missing-token message.

name: Login and Password Failures
description: Customers are unable to log in, with password or phone-number login attempts sometimes rejected.

name: Listening and Replay Charges
description: A customer objects to charges for listening to music or replaying tracks.

name: Premium Paywall Frustration
description: Customers complain that basic features or content require premium, or that premium sign-up and payment flows do not work.

name: Premium-Locked Playback Controls
description: Customers cannot freely choose, skip, or play specific songs without premium, and one reports a blank subscription purchase page.

name: Premium Cost Complaints
description: Customers object to the app requiring payment or making more features premium.

name: Missing or Unsuitable Music
description: Customers report missing songs, short clips, repetitive DJ selections, or music recommendations that do not suit them.

name: Lyrics Missing or Unavailable
description: Customers report that lyrics are missing, fail to load, or have an undesirable font.

name: Unwanted Playlist Recommendations
description: Customers continue to receive playlist recommendations despite turning the setting off, or want more current music.

name: Downloads Disappear
description: Customers report that downloaded content or other saved items disappeared.

name: Download and Offline Access Problems
description: Customers cannot download music or listen offline, and one reports downloads remaining stuck in the background.

name: Offline Playback Not Working
description: A customer reports that offline playback does not work.

name: Mixed Generic App Complaints
description: Mixed generic complaints mention missing features, a specific recap that will not open, or broad dissatisfaction without a specific defect.

name: Podcast Playback Lag
description: A customer reports that some podcasts suddenly lag during playback.

name: Connection Errors and Loading
description: Customers encounter incorrect no-internet messages, connection failures, or an app that will not load.

name: Crashes and Playback Interruptions
description: Customers report crashes, a black or loading screen, inability to open or play, and playback stopping mid-show.

name: Playback and Device Connection Issues
description: Customers report songs not playing and difficulty connecting to other devices.

name: Music Playback Fails
description: Customers say the app shuts down or will not play songs or music.

name: Random Playback Stops and Pauses
description: Customers report music or podcasts randomly stopping or pausing during playback.

name: Excessive Unskippable Ads
description: Customers complain that frequent, lengthy, or unskippable ads interrupt listening.

name: Shuffle Control Hard to Find
description: A customer cannot find the shuffle control to stop songs from shuffling.

name: Playback Controls and Shuffle Frustrations
description: Customers report unwanted shuffle, limited skips, ads interrupting music, and difficulty switching podcast formats or controlling playback.

name: Playlist and Library Controls
description: Customers have trouble finding or playing selected library and playlist songs, viewing liked songs, adding to the queue, or searching playlists.

name: Redesign and Navigation Frustrations
description: Customers find updates less usable, with changes to controls, shuffle, icons, or navigation making features harder to find or use.
